reactor_type: travelling-wave type ALD reactor (Lucida-D100, NCD Technology, Korea)
evidence: Deposition: Ru and RuO 2 films were deposited using a travelling-wave type ALD reactor (Lucida-D100, NCD Technology, Korea) at 225 /C176C. Zero-valent EBBDRu and O 2 were used as the precursor and second reactant, respectively. The basic pulsing conditions for the Ru-ALD process were set as follows: EBBDRu exposure for 5 s, O 2 exposure for 3 s and purging for 10 s, which were found to be sufficient to guarantee self-limited growth.
